name: Labid ibn Rabi'a
bio: Labid was a poet and horseman of Banu Amir ibn Sa'sa'a in the uplands of Najd and the author of one of the Mu'allaqat. He lived to meet the Prophet Muhammad and later settled in Kufa, where he reached a great age. Among the stories of his generosity is a vow to feed people whenever the east wind blew. Al-Zirikli dates his death to 41 AH (661 CE).
